summary: MB360 (1200 4th St) is a 177-unit residential building, the second of two blocks (alongside 701 China Basin St, mission_bay_mb360.geojson) in a single two-block Mission Bay apartment development originally built by BRE Properties (acquired by Essex Property Trust in 2014), with MVE + Partners as prime architect. DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016 as this block's construction-completion year.

milestones.text: Vertical construction begins on BRE Properties' two-block, ~360-unit MB360 development spanning Blocks 5 and 11 of Mission Bay
This block (1200 4th St, 177 units) is completed, per DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page

open_questions: Apartment-listing aggregators give inconsistent construction years for this address (2015 in some search summaries), while DataSF Assessor records and the project architect's own project page both give 2016; not fully reconciled.

Contemporaneous press (SFGate, CBS News San Francisco) reported a 5-alarm fire on March 11, 2014 that destroyed a 172-unit building under construction as part of MB360 -- close to this block's 177-unit count -- but no source found gives the destroyed building's street address explicitly, so the fire is not asserted here as having happened to this specific block.
Precise month of this block's actual completion/first occupancy is not sourced beyond the bare Assessor year.
Developer of record beyond BRE Properties/Essex Property Trust, and any subsequent sale history, not researched in this pass.
